competitors.name: Clean Eatz Kitchen
competitors.action: Clean Eatz Kitchen expanded its frozen pizza push by taking three classic cauliflower-crust SKUs, Cheese, Hawaiian, and Pepperoni, onto QVC, pairing better-for-you positioning with a mass discovery channel instead of relying only on grocery shelf traffic.

competitors.name: pi00a
competitors.action: The fast-growing frozen pizza brand pi00a used a Shark Tank finale appearance and a reported $200,000 Lori Greiner deal to turn mission-led founder story into national awareness, a reminder that small freezer brands can punch above their weight when the brand narrative is distinctive enough.

competitors.name: General Mills
competitors.action: General Mills disclosed plans to shutter a pizza crust facility by July as part of a broader restructuring program, which is a useful signal that even scaled incumbents are still pruning legacy production capacity instead of treating pizza-adjacent manufacturing as a guaranteed growth engine.

trends.topic: Frozen pizza growth is spreading across nontraditional channels and brand stories, not just conventional grocery
trends.magnitude: Clean Eatz is using QVC for frozen-pizza discovery while pi00a is using TV-driven founder storytelling to break through nationally.
trends.context: The useful read for Real Dough is that freezer growth is no longer only a shelf-war. Discovery channels, founder identity, and direct audience-building are increasingly part of the route to retail pull.

trends.topic: The category is rewarding nimble brand building while legacy production networks get rationalized
trends.magnitude: Challenger brands are chasing attention with media and alternative channels while General Mills is closing a pizza crust facility as part of restructuring.
trends.context: That split suggests Real Dough should keep acting like a sharp challenger brand, not assume scale alone is the moat. Shelf presence matters, but brand heat and operational flexibility matter more.

breaking.headline: Today's clearest signal is that challenger frozen-pizza brands are finding attention outside the aisle while legacy operators keep trimming infrastructure
breaking.impact: Real Dough should keep investing in a story people want to repeat, not just a premium product people notice once. QVC-style discovery, founder-led storytelling, and flexible go-to-market look more alive right now than old assumptions about scale and manufacturing footprint.
